notes: One row per flux x edge_version x bin x comparison. land_fraction is the fraction of VEGETATED land (model GPP >= 50) in that bin, shared by both comparisons within a flux x edge_version. site_fraction and n_classified/weighted_jaccard differ by comparison: 'data' = tower-measured value; 'geo_at_tower' = the same Geo raster extracted at tower coordinates. Site fractions use the classified sites as the denominator (sum to 1 per flux x edge_version x comparison).
